title: Spatial transcriptomic profiling (Visium) of meningioma

publications.title: A microenvironment-determined risk continuum refines subtyping in meningioma and reveals determinants of machine learning-based tumor classification.

corresponding_author: Sybren L N Maas, Felix Sahm
needs_manual_review_reason: Companion Visium dataset to gse-313693-snrnaseq (same paper, same Heidelberg cohort, same PMID 41663806) -- cross-linked as multi_modal_matched. FACT-CHECK UPDATE (2026-07-10): date_deposited/date_updated filled in from the live GEO record's Series_submission_date (Dec 15 2025) and Series_last_update_date (Feb 18 2026); previously both 'Not reported' despite being present in the source. DEEP-AUDIT PASS (2026-07-14): AUTHOR LIST CORRECTED: publications[0].authors had been mechanically truncated to the first 6 names; Europe PMC's authorString for PMID 41663806 confirms 69 total author entries (including the collective 'German "Aggressive Meningiomas" Consortium (KAM)' credit), now written in full. CORRESPONDING AUTHOR CONFIRMED AND CORRECTED (minor): direct contrib-group xref check of PMC12900647.xml (Europe PMC fullTextXML) confirms exactly two corresponding-author (✉) xrefs: 'Maas Sybren L N' and 'Sahm Felix'; corresponding_author corrected from 'Sybren N Maas' to 'Sybren L N Maas' to match the paper's own middle-initial rendering exactly (Sahm unchanged). HIDDEN PER-SAMPLE DATA FOUND IN FULL TEXT: the paper states verbatim 'we conducted spatial transcriptomics on 42 samples from 37 different meningiomas... trained a graph attention network (GAN)... Confusion matrix of the predicted (from spatial transcriptomics) versus ground truth (MC from epigenetic profiling)' -- i.e. every one of the 42 GSE313694 samples has a known ground-truth DKFZ Molecular Class (MC) from bulk methylation, used as the training/validation label for this exact dataset. molecular_subtype_annotated corrected from false to true (tags updated to match). grade_breakdown left null: no exact per-grade sample count specific to the 42/37 cohort was found in the text checked (only the qualitative overall_design phrase 'across WHO grades and methylation classes'); not guessed. has_outcome_data left false: the paper's Data Availability statement explicitly states 'DNA methylation and clinical outcome data can be shared after completion of a data transfer agreement for noncommercial use' -- i.e. outcome data exists for this cohort but is NOT part of the public GSE313694/GSE313693 deposits and requires a separate controlled-access request, consistent with this corpus's convention of not counting access-gated data as 'has_outcome_data' for the public accession itself.

gene_expression_viewer.sample_label: All 42 samples, each spot plotted at its true tissue position, side by side -- the largest single viewer artifact in this inventory
gene_expression_viewer.embedding_method: scanpy 1.10.3: read_10x_h5 of each sample's deposited raw feature-barcode .h5 (a mix of standard Visium and newer CytAssist chemistry -- CytAssist samples have a much higher spot density, confirmed via cytassist_image.tiff present in their spatial bundles), joined against each sample's own tissue_positions.csv/tissue_positions_list.csv (extracted from each sample's own spatial.tar.gz into an isolated per-sample directory, since the archives' internal folder names do not match their external GEO filenames -- e.g. GSM-labeled 'MNG_Sample_01_spatial.tar.gz' contains an internal 'A_MNG_BI_01_spatial/' folder), kept in_tissue==1 spots only, QC (min 100 genes/spot), anndata.concat with each sample's array_col offset so all 42 tissue sections render side by side. Plotted coordinates are the TRUE physical Visium hex-grid position, not a UMAP. Clustering (Leiden, resolution 0.5, 38 clusters) uses transcriptional similarity via PCA/neighbors. Gene panel trimmed to 25 (post-hoc, from an already-ranked list, no recomputation) to keep the 239,399-spot artifact under GitHub's 50MB warning threshold -- an initial 70-gene export was 90.9MB.
gene_expression_viewer.integration_note: Spots are plotted at true tissue position per sample, not merged into one shared coordinate space -- the 42 samples are independent tissue sections side by side, not directly overlaid. This is the largest single dataset in this inventory's viewer (239,399 spots across 42 samples).
